Kiswahili: Ili kuepuka kununua mbegu bandia za mahindi, tafuta stika yenye msimbo wa kukwaruza kwenye pakiti ya mbegu, ukwaruze msimbo huo, na utume kwa nambari ya bure ya uthibitishaji ili kuhakiki uhalisi kabla ya kupanda - kama alivyosema Naibu Mkurugenzi wa Uthibitishaji wa Mbegu wa KEPHIS, Ephraim Wachira: 'Stika hii ndiyo inayosaidia wakulima kutofautisha kati ya mbegu halisi na bandia.'
Source: The Standard, "Farmers risk losing half their harvest, agency warns" (standardmedia.co.ke/counties/article/2001547918), quoting KEPHIS Deputy Director for Seed Certification Ephraim Wachira
Metadata: tone=warning; platform=news article with direct agency quote; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en

English: To manage bacterial wilt in enset, sterilize cutting tools with 70% alcohol or bleach (or heat them until red-hot) before and after each plant, dig out and bury diseased plants deep in a pit, use disease-free seedlings, rotate with cereal or pulse crops (not banana), and fence the field to keep out animals that can spread the disease.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mnyauko bakteria wa enset (mgomba wa Kihabeshi), safisha zana za kukatia kwa kiwango cha asilimia 70 cha pombe au dawa ya bleach (au zichome hadi ziwe nyekundu) kabla na baada ya kila mmea, chimba na uzike mimea iliyoathirika kirefu shimoni, tumia miche isiyo na ugonjwa, badilisha na mazao ya nafaka au jamii ya mikunde (si migomba), na zungushia uzio shambani ili kuzuia wanyama wanaoweza kueneza ugonjwa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Controlling bacterial wilt of enset using cultural methods", Created in Ethiopia, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800326.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ethiopia

English: To manage groundnut rosette disease, plant early with the first good rains (late planting attracts more aphids that spread the virus), use the correct plant spacing, plant resistant varieties (in Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), and uproot and destroy (burn or bury) infected plants.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa rosette wa karanga, panda mapema wakati wa mvua za kwanza nzuri (kupanda kuchelewa huvutia utitiri wengi wanaoeneza virusi), tumia nafasi sahihi ya upandaji, panda aina zinazostahimili (nchini Malawi: Nsinjilo, Chalimbana 2005, Chitala, Baka), na ng'oa na angamize (choma au zika) mimea iliyoathirika.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of Rosette in Groundnuts", Created in Malawi, July 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800237.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi

English: To control fruit flies in mango orchards, make simple traps from small plastic containers with a hanging cotton wick, drench the wick with a 10-20% pesticide solution (such as malathion, fenthion, or deltamethrin) plus a lure like methyl eugenol, and hang the traps in and around the orchard - flies are attracted by the lure and killed by the pesticide.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti nzi wa matunda kwenye mashamba ya maembe, tengeneza mitego rahisi kutoka vyombo vidogo vya plastiki na utambi uliotundikwa, loweka utambi kwa myeyusho wa asilimia 10-20 ya dawa ya kuulia wadudu (kama malathion, fenthion, au deltamethrin) pamoja na kivutia kama methyl eugenol, kisha tundika mitego ndani na kuzunguka shamba - nzi huvutwa na kivutia hicho na kuuawa na dawa.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Management of fruit flies in mangoes using traps", Created in Malawi, August 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800330.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi

English: Banana Xanthomonas wilt is not yet in Ghana, but if you spot it: immediately uproot infected plants, cut them into pieces and bury deep away from the farm; remove the male bud with a forked stick (not a cutlass) before it opens; disinfect farm tools with 10% bleach or fire; and never take planting material (suckers) from an infected farm.
Kiswahili: Ugonjwa wa mnyauko wa Xanthomonas kwenye migomba bado haujafika Ghana, lakini ukiuona: ng'oa mara moja mimea iliyoathirika, ikate vipande na uizike kirefu mbali na shamba; ondoa chipukizi la kiume kwa kijiti chenye ncha mbili (si panga) kabla halijachanua; safisha zana za shambani kwa dawa ya bleach asilimia 10 au moto; na kamwe usichukue vipando kutoka shamba lililoathirika.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "How to Recognise Banana Xanthomonas Wilt", Created in Ghana, May 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800917.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=high; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ghana

English: To limit the spread of eucalyptus gall wasp, never transport or distribute seedlings from an infected nursery to disease-free areas, remove and burn affected plant parts and fallen leaves (especially September-November), and be aware that registered chemical treatments for this pest are not yet available in Ethiopia.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza kuenea kwa nyigu wa magamba ya mikaratusi, kamwe usisafirishe au kugawa miche kutoka kitalu kilichoathirika kwenda maeneo yasiyo na ugonjwa, ondoa na choma sehemu za mimea zilizoathirika na majani yaliyoanguka (hasa Septemba-Novemba), na fahamu kuwa dawa za kemikali zilizosajiliwa kwa wadudu hawa bado hazipatikani nchini Ethiopia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Eucalyptus gall wasp (Blue gum chalcid)", Created in Ethiopia, October 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167801209.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ethiopia

English: To manage boron deficiency in pawpaw, apply 5-10kg of well-decomposed manure per plant annually at the start of the rainy season, and apply 0.5-5g of Borax fertilizer around the base of young plants; for mature plants, a foliar spray of water-soluble boron corrects the deficiency faster than soil application.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti upungufu wa boroni kwenye mapapai, weka kilo 5-10 za samadi iliyooza vizuri kwa kila mmea kila mwaka mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua, na weka gramu 0.5-5 za mbolea ya Borax karibu na shina la mche mchanga; kwa mimea iliyokomaa, kunyunyizia majani dawa ya boroni inayoyeyuka majini hurekebisha upungufu haraka zaidi kuliko kuweka udongoni.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Prevention of boron deficiency in pawpaw", Created in Malawi, July 2018, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20197800173.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Malawi

English: Plant certified seeds using the correct planting methods - as KALRO Director Robert Musyoki puts it, this is 'the best way' to address Kenya's food deficit; certified seeds 'guarantee improved productivity and resilience,' according to KALRO Research Officer Samuel Kiiru.
Kiswahili: Panda mbegu zilizothibitishwa ukitumia mbinu sahihi za upandaji - kama alivyosema Mkurugenzi wa KALRO Robert Musyoki, hii ndiyo 'njia bora zaidi' ya kukabiliana na uhaba wa chakula nchini Kenya; mbegu zilizothibitishwa 'huhakikisha uzalishaji bora na ustahimilivu,' kwa mujibu wa Afisa Utafiti wa KALRO Samuel Kiiru.
Source: Kenya News Agency, "Plant certified seeds to enhance food Security, KALRO urges farmers" (kenyanews.go.ke/plant-certified-seeds-to-enhance-food-security-kalro-urges-farmers-2/), quoting KALRO Director Robert Musyoki and Research Officer Samuel Kiiru

English: To control nematodes in tomatoes without chemicals, plant Red Sunhemp (2kg seed per lima) in the field 3-3.5 months before growing tomatoes - its roots release a chemical that repels nematodes. Remove or plough in the Sunhemp plants after harvesting their seed, then plant your tomatoes.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti minyoo fundo (nematodes) kwenye nyanya bila kemikali, panda Red Sunhemp (kilo 2 za mbegu kwa lima moja) shambani miezi 3-3.5 kabla ya kupanda nyanya - mizizi yake hutoa kemikali inayofukuza minyoo hiyo. Ondoa au lima mimea ya Sunhemp baada ya kuvuna mbegu zake, kisha panda nyanya zako.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Red Sunhemp against nematodes in tomatoes", Created in Zambia, August 2013, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20147801411.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To manage black Sigatoka in bananas, check your field weekly from planting until the tree matures. If you see an infected leaf, cut it carefully, bag it, and burn or bury it away from the field; if a whole tree is badly infected, cut it down and destroy it immediately. Always clean your tools with ethanol, bleach, or fire between uses.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa Black Sigatoka kwenye migomba, kagua shamba lako kila wiki tangu kupanda hadi mgomba unapokomaa. Ukiona jani lililoathirika, likate kwa uangalifu, liweke kwenye mfuko, na ulichome au ulizike mbali na shamba; kama mgomba mzima umeathirika vibaya, ukate na uuangamize mara moja. Safisha zana zako kwa ethanoli, bleach, au moto kati ya matumizi.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Reducing Black Sigatoka in your Banana field", Created in Congo (DRC), May 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800101.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=DR Congo

English: To protect stored maize from insect pests using an airtight metal silo: load only clean, dry maize (13% moisture or less), place a lit candle inside on a tray, then seal the silo. The candle burns up the oxygen and goes out on its own (5-20 minutes), and the resulting low-oxygen environment kills the insects without chemicals.
Kiswahili: Ili kulinda mahindi yaliyohifadhiwa dhidi ya wadudu kwa kutumia ghala la chuma lisilopitisha hewa: jaza mahindi safi na makavu tu (unyevu wa asilimia 13 au chini), weka mshumaa uliowashwa ndani kwenye trei, kisha funga ghala vizuri. Mshumaa hutumia oksijeni yote na kuzimika wenyewe (dakika 5-20), na mazingira hayo ya oksijeni kidogo huua wadudu bila kemikali.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Grain storage in metal silos against insect pests", Created in Zambia, July 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20157800264.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To manage bacterial black spot in mango, prune off and destroy diseased twigs (sterilizing your tools between cuts), spray copper oxychloride-based products as soon as the disease appears nearby - before it infects your trees. Avoid spraying during fruit set, and do not enter the orchard for at least a day after spraying.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ugonjwa wa madoa meusi ya bakteria kwenye maembe, kata na uangamize matawi yaliyoathirika (ukisafisha zana kati ya kila ukataji), nyunyizia dawa zenye copper oxychloride mara ugonjwa unapoonekana karibu - kabla haujaathiri miti yako. Epuka kunyunyizia wakati wa kutunga matunda, na usiingie shambani kwa angalau siku moja baada ya kunyunyizia.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Copper against bacterial black spot in mango", Created in Zambia, December 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800022.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To control mango pulp weevil, harvest fruits earlier than usual (before fully ripe), and remove and bury fallen fruit debris at least 50cm deep (or compost it under at least 1m of other material) to stop weevils hatching and reinfesting the crop.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti mdudu wa pulp wa maembe, vuna matunda mapema kuliko kawaida (kabla hayajaiva kabisa), na ondoa na uzike mabaki ya matunda yaliyoanguka kwa kina cha angalau sentimita 50 (au yatengeneze mboji chini ya safu ya angalau mita 1 ya nyenzo nyingine) ili kuzuia mdudu huyo kuanguliwa na kushambulia zao tena.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Cultural control of mango pulp weevil", Created in Zambia, July 2015, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800147.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To control anthracnose in African eggplant, buy a Mancozeb-based fungicide from a registered agro-dealer (avoid Mancozeb-Metalaxyl mixes), mix 40g per 20 litres of water plus 2 tablespoons of liquid soap as a sticker, and spray mid-morning or late afternoon avoiding wind and drought-stressed plants; observe a two-week pre-harvest interval.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti anthracnose kwenye biringanya, nunua dawa ya kuvu yenye Mancozeb kutoka kwa muuzaji wa pembejeo aliyesajiliwa (epuka mchanganyiko wa Mancozeb-Metalaxyl), changanya gramu 40 kwa lita 20 za maji pamoja na vijiko viwili vya sabuni ya majimaji kama kishikizi, na nyunyizia asubuhi ya kati au jioni ukiepuka upepo na mimea iliyodhoofishwa na ukame; zingatia muda wa wiki mbili kabla ya kuvuna.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Protect African eggplant from anthracnose", Created in Zambia, September 2014, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20167800027.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To control powdery mildew in okra without synthetic chemicals, pound 1.5kg of fresh neem leaves and soak in 16 litres of water for 24 hours, sieve, add 50g of soft soap as a sticker, then spray the whole plant, repeating after 2 weeks if symptoms persist. Stop spraying 10-14 days before harvest.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti ukungu unga (powdery mildew) kwenye bamia bila kemikali za viwandani, twanga kilo 1.5 za majani mabichi ya mwarobaini na uyaroweke kwenye lita 16 za maji kwa masaa 24, chuja, ongeza gramu 50 za sabuni laini kama kishikizi, kisha nyunyizia mmea mzima, ukirudia baada ya wiki 2 kama dalili zinaendelea. Acha kunyunyizia siku 10-14 kabla ya kuvuna.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Neem extract to control powdery mildew in okra", Created in Zambia, September 2016, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177800425.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=low; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: To control Kapinga (Bermuda grass) in maize fields, spray glyphosate on actively growing weeds a few days after rain (240ml per 16L water) before planting, then plant maize a day or more later; before or after maize germinates, spray Atrazine over moist soil (320ml per 16L water). Always follow label instructions and wear protective equipment.
Kiswahili: Ili kudhibiti gugu la Kapinga (nyasi ya Bermuda) kwenye mashamba ya mahindi, nyunyizia glyphosate kwenye magugu yanayokua kikamilifu siku chache baada ya mvua (mililita 240 kwa lita 16 za maji) kabla ya kupanda, kisha panda mahindi siku moja au zaidi baadaye; kabla au baada ya mahindi kuota, nyunyizia Atrazine juu ya udongo wenye unyevu (mililita 320 kwa lita 16 za maji). Fuata maelekezo ya lebo kila wakati na uvae vifaa vya kujikinga.
Source: CABI Plantwise "Factsheets for Farmers" - "Kapinga management with herbicides in maize", Created in Zambia, July 2017, CC-BY-SA 4.0 (factsheetadmin.plantwise.org/Uploads/PDFs/20177801256.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=CABI Plantwise factsheet; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Zambia

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, Kenya's Meteorological Department and agriculture ministry advise crop farmers to heavily mulch their fields, practice minimum tillage, construct tied ridges, and invest in rainwater harvesting structures to conserve soil moisture.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kipindi cha ukame kinachotarajiwa, Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ya Kenya na Wizara ya Kilimo wanashauri wakulima wa mazao kufunika udongo kwa matandazo mengi, kufanya kilimo cha kuvuruga udongo kidogo, kujenga matuta yanayofungwa (tied ridges), na kuwekeza kwenye miundo ya kuvuna maji ya mvua ili kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo.
Source: Kenya Meteorological Department, monthly climate advisory reported in "Farmers Told to Conserve Moisture as Kenya Met Predicts Cold, Dry Conditions Throughout July" (kenyans.co.ke/news/124954)

English: Ahead of a forecast dry spell, livestock keepers - especially in Kenya's arid and semi-arid areas - are advised to conserve existing fodder, manage water supplies carefully, and shield animals from temperature extremes.
Kiswahili: Kabla ya kipindi cha ukame kinachotarajiwa, wafugaji wa mifugo - hasa katika maeneo kame na nusu-kame ya Kenya - wanashauriwa kuhifadhi malisho yaliyopo, kusimamia vyanzo vya maji kwa uangalifu, na kukinga wanyama dhidi ya joto kali.
Source: Kenya Meteorological Department, monthly climate advisory reported in "Farmers Told to Conserve Moisture as Kenya Met Predicts Cold, Dry Conditions Throughout July" (kenyans.co.ke/news/124954)

English: Harvest tomatoes in the early morning or late evening when the temperature is around 20C and the weather is dry. For storage, keep tomatoes at 12C and 86-90% relative humidity - they spoil if kept below 10C for over 2 weeks, or below 5C for more than 6-8 days, but can last 2-3 weeks at 10C or above.
Kiswahili: Vuna nyanya asubuhi na mapema au jioni wakati joto liko karibu na nyuzi 20 na hali ya hewa ikiwa kavu. Kwa uhifadhi, weka nyanya kwenye joto la nyuzi 12 na unyevu wa hewa wa asilimia 86-90 - huharibika zikiwa chini ya nyuzi 10 kwa zaidi ya wiki 2, au chini ya nyuzi 5 kwa zaidi ya siku 6-8, lakini zinaweza kudumu wiki 2-3 kwenye nyuzi 10 au zaidi.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Reducing post-harvest losses in tomatoes" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-reducing-post-harvest-losses-in-tomatoes/)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International backgrounder; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en

English: Leaving common bean roots in the soil after harvest adds an extra 20-60kg of nitrogen per hectare, available for the next crop - equivalent to 3/4-2 free bags of urea. With good agricultural practices, common bean can yield over 800kg per acre.
Kiswahili: Baada ya kuvuna, mizizi ya maharage hubakia kwenye udongo na huongeza kilo 20-60 zaidi za nitrojeni kwenye udongo kwa hekta moja, ambayo itatumika kwa zao litakalofuata - sawa na mifuko 3/4-2 zaidi ya urea. Kwa kutumia mbinu sahihi za kilimo bora cha maharage, mavuno yanaweza kuwa zaidi ya kilo 800 kwa ekari.
Source: Farm Radio International, "Backgrounder: Growing common bean" (scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/backgrounder-growing-common-bean/, Swahili: scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/nakala-juu-ya-kilimo-cha-maharage/), Tanzania
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=Farm Radio International backgrounder; urgency=low; country=Tanzania
